fluff.overview: The Marian Hegemony Armed Forces organize their conventional infantry along Roman legionary lines, with formations structured into contubernia, centuries, and cohorts rather than the squads and platoons used by Inner Sphere armies. A triplus contubernium, or triple tent-group, combines three squads of ten. Jump-capable triplus contubernia are among the more capable light infantry formations in the MHAF, able to conduct company-scale airborne insertions and rapid seizure of key terrain features. Support squads operate portable machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire, providing suppression capability against enemy infantry and light vehicles.
